_doc: Chatterbox examples. English runs on Turbo (inline tags in square brackets), German on Multilingual V3 (no tags; exaggeration/cfg via instruct, syntax 'exaggeration=0.8 cfg=0.3'; model=mtl3|turbo|kartoffel selects the sub-model).

samples.text: Honestly, I did not expect the proof to work on the first try. It did, and now I have to explain why.
samples.note: Turbo without tags: base sound of the voice, reference for the tag variants.

samples.text: Honestly, I did not expect the proof to work on the first try [laugh]. It did, and now I have to explain why [sigh].
samples.note: Same sentence with [laugh] and [sigh]: a real laugh after 'try', an audible sigh at the end.

samples.text: Let me just [clear throat] start again. The lecture begins at nine [cough], sorry, at nine thirty.
samples.note: [clear throat] and [cough] as sounds mid-sentence; the text should continue cleanly afterwards.

samples.text: Oh, you thought the exam was easy? [chuckle] Wait until you see question four. [gasp] It has three parts.
[whispering] Do not tell anyone, but the solution is on page twelve.
samples.note: Style tag [whispering] at the start: should sound quieter and breathy. Style tags are weaker than sound tags.

samples.text: The function is NOT symmetric. You have to compute it in THIS order, not the other way around.
samples.note: Emphasis through capitals: NOT and THIS should be audibly stressed (often only weakly with Turbo).

samples.text: Honestly, I did not expect the proof to work on the first try. It did, and now I have to explain why.
samples.note: Same sentence as en_plain, but through Multilingual V3 instead of Turbo: sound comparison of the two sub-models (slower).

samples.text: Ehrlich gesagt hätte ich nicht gedacht, dass der Beweis beim ersten Versuch klappt. Jetzt muss ich erklären, warum.
samples.note: Multilingual V3 with default values (exaggeration 0.5, cfg 0.5).

samples.text: Ehrlich gesagt hätte ich nicht gedacht, dass der Beweis beim ersten Versuch klappt. Jetzt muss ich erklären, warum.
samples.note: Same sentence with high exaggeration and low cfg: livelier, more emphasis, often a bit faster.

samples.text: Ehrlich gesagt hätte ich nicht gedacht, dass der Beweis beim ersten Versuch klappt. Jetzt muss ich erklären, warum.
samples.note: Same sentence, calm and matter-of-fact: low exaggeration, good for long technical texts.

samples.text: Was? Die Klausur ist schon morgen? Das kann doch nicht wahr sein!
samples.note: Agitated text with maximum exaggeration: exclamations and questions should sound clearly emotional.

samples.text: Die Divergenz ist NICHT symmetrisch. Man muss sie in DIESER Reihenfolge berechnen.
samples.note: Capital-letter emphasis in German: Multilingual barely reacts to it; mainly a test of whether it triggers spelling out.

samples.text: Ein neuronales Netz lernt, indem es den Gradienten der Verlustfunktion bezüglich seiner Gewichte berechnet und diese in kleinen Schritten anpasst.
samples.note: Typical read-aloud text with technical terms: pronunciation and intonation over a longer sentence.

samples.text: Ehrlich gesagt hätte ich nicht gedacht, dass der Beweis beim ersten Versuch klappt. Jetzt muss ich erklären, warum.
samples.note: Same sentence as de_plain through Kartoffelbox v0.2 (German community fine-tune) instead of Multilingual V3: compares pronunciation and intonation. Loads an extra 1 GB of VRAM on first use.

samples.text: Ein neuronales Netz lernt, indem es den Gradienten der Verlustfunktion bezüglich seiner Gewichte berechnet und diese in kleinen Schritten anpasst.
samples.note: Like de_fach, but with the cloned male voice de_male_1.

samples.text: Honestly, I did not expect the proof to work on the first try [laugh]. It did, and now I have to explain why [sigh].
samples.note: Tags with the cloned voice en_female_1 instead of a built-in one: do the sounds work with a foreign voice too?
